title: Comparison subjects
description: The stacks being compared, in render order. Exactly one carries is_self, and only that one may hold generated cells.

id.description: Stable identity, and the basename of observations/<id>.json.

language.description: The implementation language, not the languages it has bindings for.

repository.description: Where the evidence was read from. A subject with no readable source cannot hold a measured observation.

is_self.description: True for this repository, and for no other stack. Gates the generated confidence tier.

capability_inventory.description: True when this independent subject registry requires a leaf capability ledger and exact-ID inventory.
